title: Vanishing of Complex Integrals for Negative Time
expert_review: A rigorous derivation that synthesizes functional decay, trigonometric inequalities, and contour integration. Essential for understanding Inverse Laplace Transform convergence.
learning_objectives: Combine multiple mathematical results to solve complex proofs
Analyze the behavior of complex integrals on semi-circular arcs at infinity
Explain the role of time $t$ in the convergence of the Bromwich integral
Apply the Squeeze Theorem to complex magnitude bounds
